source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: 45 native observations, all accepted full-LCD/status key replays, saved directly to project.

Implicit multiplication binds tighter than explicit multiplication/division. Native 6/2(1+2)=1, 6/2*(1+2)=9, 6/2sqrt(9)=1, 6/2sin(30)=6 and 2pi/2pi=1. After evaluating, implicit denominator products acquire visible parentheses, also when recalled for editing. Unclosed original groups retain omitted closing parentheses.

Nested power 2^(3^(2))=512. Separately closed LineI powers 2^(3)^(2)=64, 2^(-3)^(2)=1/64; Ans/64=1 confirms memory. The independent surd base (sqrt(2))^(2)^(3)=8 confirms the symbolic path. Legacy 580 associativity is retained.

In MathI, pressing power immediately after leaving a power is ignored, so the subsequent digit sits at baseline; 2^3 followed by a baseline 2 gives Syntax ERROR. The initial sequential/empty-base labels were renamed to match observed behavior. Grouping (2^3)^2 is valid and yields64.
Negative sign before a square/power applies outside it; explicit parentheses change the base. Negative exponents, adjacent groups and automatic closing at evaluation were measured.

Nested script shifts by four pixels rather than six; superscript after a tall parenthesized group rises with that group. A 16-pixel radical-height parenthesis pair was sampled, with an independent sqrt(16) divisor holdout.
